what_does_it_do: Establishes a new IS-05 transport for NMOS Senders and Receivers implementing MXL and allows Controllers to establish compatible connections.
Establishes a standardized mechanism for NMOS Senders and Receivers to declare support for MXL.
why_does_it_matter: An NMOS Controller can connect compatible MXL Receivers to MXL Senders.
how_does_it_work: Documents how MXL capabilities are announced by both Senders and Receivers.
Outlines the requirements for Senders, Receivers, and Controllers regarding MXL support.
